h1: Brighton Hotel & Residence Bangkok — 4-Star, Indoor Pool with a Free Shuttle Straight to BITEC
intro: If you have an event at BITEC Bang Na and want a proper 4-star stay — spacious room, indoor pool, and a shuttle that takes you to the venue without hunting for a cab — Brighton Hotel & Residence Bangkok is the most practical choice in the area. The hotel sits on Sanphawut Road in Bang Na, offers 146 rooms from 38 to 72 sqm, an indoor saltwater pool, a fitness centre, a restaurant, and free parking for 90 cars. BTS Bang Na station is roughly 950 metres away, around a 12-to-13-minute walk. BITEC itself is 3.2 km further out, but the hotel runs a complimentary scheduled shuttle to BITEC, BTS Bang Na and Central Bangna for all guests. Score: 8.4 from 272 Trip.com reviews. Rooms start from around ฿1,400 per night in quiet periods — prices spike noticeably when a major BITEC show is in town.

body.html: Brighton Hotel & Residence first opened around 2012 and went through a renovation in 2024. The building is a 13-storey tower on Sanphawut Road — modern-looking in a straightforward, unfussy way, set in the quieter residential-commercial pocket of Bang Na Nuea. The most consistent thing guests praise is how big the rooms are for the price: Deluxe Rooms start at 38 sqm, Junior Suites hit 52 sqm, and Executive Suites reach 72 sqm — substantially larger than what you would get for the equivalent rate at a hotel closer to Sukhumvit.

Service scores highest of all on Trip.com at 8.8/10, and the reviews back that up: guests regularly call out the front-desk team for being friendly, fast and helpful with transport arrangements. The Brighton Bistro breakfast buffet earns its share of praise too — Thai dishes, Asian options and international staples, running from 6 am, which works well if you need to be at a BITEC booth before the doors open. Free parking for 90 cars is a genuine bonus for anyone driving in from outside Bangkok.
"The room was huge, clean, and the staff at the front desk were genuinely helpful. The shuttle to BITEC saved us a lot of hassle. Solid value for a four-star."

The indoor saltwater pool is the facility that sets Brighton apart from most rivals in the area. It sits under a sheltered roof with natural light filtering in — calmer and more usable than an outdoor pool in Bangkok's afternoon heat. There is a separate children's pool, which makes the hotel work well for families too. The fitness centre is on the smaller side but functional. The combination of pool, gym and free parking is unusual in this price bracket for Bang Na.

On location: BTS Bang Na is about 950 metres from the hotel — a 12-to-13-minute walk in the heat, manageable but not exactly a breezy stroll. BITEC is 3.2 km away; walking it is not realistic. What makes this work is the free hotel shuttle, which runs on a fixed schedule to BITEC, BTS Bang Na and Central Bangna. Guests attending BITEC events consistently flag this as one of the most convenient arrangements in the area — just confirm the departure times at check-in.

To be straight about the weak points: Wi-Fi is the most common complaint in recent reviews — slow, inconsistent, and genuinely frustrating if you need a reliable connection for remote work or video calls. The building has an open central atrium that lets noise travel between floors, and rooms facing Sanphawut Road can pick up road traffic in the early morning. Some guests have noted dated bathroom fixtures — rusted taps or slow drainage — in rooms that were not fully upgraded. These are real issues, not nitpicks.

The overall picture: for BITEC visitors who want four-star space, an indoor pool and a free shuttle at a price well below what a comparable hotel in Sukhumvit would cost, Brighton Bangkok delivers. A score of 8.4 from 272 Trip.com reviews and 7.8 on Booking.com (268 reviews) tells you that the majority of guests leave satisfied, with staff and room size as the main positives. Rates start from around ฿1,400 per night in off-peak periods — book early when a major show is scheduled, because prices and availability shift fast.

honestSummary: Brighton Bangkok is the best-value 4-star option for BITEC visitors who want a real room, an indoor pool and a shuttle that removes the transport headache — at a price well below equivalent hotels on Sukhumvit. Wi-Fi is the biggest unresolved weakness; early-morning road noise is a secondary concern worth flagging to light sleepers.
honestChecks: If you need reliable internet for remote work or video calls — Wi-Fi has a poor track record here. Bring a local SIM or mobile hotspot as a backup before you arrive.
If you are a light sleeper — Sanphawut Road gets noisy in the early morning and the open atrium carries sound between floors. Request a higher floor room away from the street side when booking.
If you plan to walk to BITEC — it is 3.2 km away; do not attempt it. Use the free hotel shuttle instead, and confirm the schedule at check-in — departure times matter when a show opens early.

tips.title: Check the shuttle timetable before you arrive
tips.body: The free shuttle to BITEC, BTS Bang Na and Central Bangna runs on a fixed schedule — ask the hotel for departure times when you book and again at check-in. Some departures are very early, timed for exhibition opening hours.

tips.title: Bring a local SIM or mobile hotspot
tips.body: Wi-Fi at the hotel has a well-documented track record of being slow and dropping out, especially when the hotel is at capacity during a BITEC show. If your work depends on a stable connection, bring your own backup.

tips.title: Request a high floor room on the courtyard side
tips.body: Sanphawut Road generates traffic noise from early morning and the open central atrium carries sound between floors. A higher-floor room away from the street makes a real difference for a good night's sleep.

tips.title: Swim before the day starts
tips.body: The indoor pool opens from early morning and is at its quietest before 8 am. A short swim before the shuttle run to BITEC is the best way to make use of the facility — and a practical way to reset after a long show day.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Brighton Hotel & Residence Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Brighton Hotel Bangkok and how do I get to BITEC?
faq.a: The hotel is at 222 Sanphawut Road, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260. BITEC is 3.2 km away — the hotel operates a complimentary scheduled shuttle to BITEC, BTS Bang Na and Central Bangna for all guests. BTS Bang Na station is closer, about 950 metres (12-13 min walk) from the hotel.

faq.q: Does Brighton Hotel Bangkok offer a free shuttle to BITEC?
faq.a: Yes. The shuttle is free for all hotel guests and runs on a fixed timetable to BITEC, BTS Bang Na and Central Plaza Bangna. Confirm departure times with reception at check-in, especially during major shows when demand is highest.

faq.q: What are the room types and prices at Brighton Hotel Bangkok?
faq.a: Four room types: Deluxe Room (38 sqm) from approx. ฿1,400/night, Junior Suite (52 sqm) from approx. ฿1,900, Family Suite (55 sqm) from approx. ฿2,400, and Executive Suite (72 sqm) from approx. ฿2,900. Prices rise sharply during BITEC events — book well in advance.

faq.q: Does Brighton Hotel Bangkok have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — an indoor saltwater swimming pool plus a separate children's pool. The indoor setting keeps it cooler than an outdoor pool and means it is usable year-round regardless of weather. It opens early, making it practical for a swim before heading to a morning session at BITEC.

faq.q: Who is Brighton Hotel Bangkok best suited for?
faq.a: Best for business travellers and exhibitors attending BITEC events who want a 4-star hotel with a real pool, spacious rooms and a free shuttle — at a price significantly lower than equivalent hotels in Sukhumvit. Also works well for families who need free parking and a family suite. Less suitable for tourists focused on Bangkok's central nightlife or shopping districts.
